title: studio.page.rolled_back.v1
description: A studio owner or admin made an older published version of a builder page live again (synthwerk#46, #106). The draft did not change. CloudEvents subject: the page id. The orgid extension and data.org_id hold the identity org id. actor: user:<sub> of the owner or admin. No page content: no title, no section text. Identity copies it to the audit list of the org.

slug.description: URL slug of the page. Never free text.

version.description: The older version that is live now.

previous_version.description: The live version before the roll back. null: nothing was live, for example after an unpublish (synthwerk#108). The builder has no unpublish yet.
